basics.name: Théophile Sanchez
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher in machine learning applied to genomics
basics.summary: Postdoctoral researcher specializing in machine learning applied to genomics, with expertise in deep learning applications for population genetics and environmental DNA (eDNA) analysis. Experienced in research, teaching, mentoring, and open-source software development.

work.name: ETH Zurich, Environmental Physics Group
work.summary: Data manager for the AtlantECO project under the supervision of Meike Vogt, focusing on environmental data management and analysis.

work.name: ETH Zurich & WSL, Ecosystems and Landscape Evolution Group
work.summary: Postdoctoral work on the DNAi project, applying artificial intelligence to environmental DNA for ecosystem monitoring.

work.name: Paris-Saclay University / LISN / TAU Group
work.summary: Doctoral research on deep learning for population genetics under the supervision of Guillaume Charpiat and Flora Jay.

work.name: Polytech & Paris-Saclay University
work.summary: Taught Computer Science and Bioinformatics courses as part of a non-tenured teaching and research appointment.

education.institution: INSA Lyon (National Institute of Applied Science)
